name: next-steps
description: Choose from suggested follow-up prompts after each turn, using number keys to place a suggestion in the input field before sending it.
sourceDescription: After each turn, 2 or 3 likely next prompts above the prompt. Press 1, 2 or 3 in an empty prompt to draft one, 0 to dismiss.
author: Hamza Zafar

category.label: Prompt Mods
category.basis: Helps compose, select, queue or navigate input.
